description: Project-neutral AACP controls. A control names one weakness, the A-G property it bears on, and a probe contract: the scenario any binding must implement for the result to be comparable across projects. A control observes a weakness; it never certifies its absence. See docs/CONTROLS.md.

result_vocabulary.OBSERVED: the probe reproduced the weakness on the pristine subject
result_vocabulary.NOT_OBSERVED: the probe ran and did not reproduce the weakness; this is not a PASS
result_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: the binding declares the subject has no such mechanism, with a reason
result_vocabulary.NON_VERDICT: the probe could not reach a verdict (pin, bytes, build or harness failure)

discrimination_vocabulary.DISCRIMINATES: with the declared repair applied alone, the probe no longer observes the weakness
discrimination_vocabulary.DOES_NOT_DISCRIMINATE: the probe still observes the weakness with the repair applied, so it does not test that weakness
discrimination_vocabulary.BUILD_ERROR: the repaired subject did not build; not counted as discrimination
discrimination_vocabulary.ANCHOR_ERROR: the repair anchor is not unique in the pristine file
discrimination_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: no repair declared (static probes may omit it)

controls.title: Use-limited authorization survives a persistence boundary
controls.question: Does a single-use or count-limited authorization stay exhausted after the system batches, compacts, rotates or persists its usage state?

probe_contract.setup: Issue an authorization limited to N uses (N = 1 is sufficient).
probe_contract.stimulus: Use it N times, confirm the next use is refused, then cause the usage state to cross the boundary (batch commit, log rotation, restart, compaction).
probe_contract.observation: The weakness is OBSERVED if the authorization is accepted again after the boundary.
probe_contract.repair: Count uses across all persisted state.

controls.title: Revocation fails closed
controls.question: When a revocation record exists for an artifact but cannot be verified, does the system still treat the artifact as valid?

probe_contract.setup: A valid, verifiable artifact.
probe_contract.stimulus: Attach a revocation record for it whose signature does not verify.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the artifact is still accepted.
probe_contract.repair: Treat the presence of an unverifiable revocation as invalidating, or reject the record loudly.

controls.title: Signed artifact verified against a key it carries
controls.question: Is a signed artifact authenticated against a key embedded in the artifact itself rather than a trust anchor held by the verifier?

probe_contract.setup: A verifier with no trust relationship to an attacker key.
probe_contract.stimulus: Present an artifact with forged content, signed by the attacker key, carrying that key.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the verifier accepts it.
probe_contract.repair: Verify against verifier-held trusted keys only.

controls.title: Approval or vote has no freshness binding
controls.question: Does a signed approval or vote omit a nonce, epoch, height or expiry, so it remains valid for replay?

probe_contract.setup: One signed approval or vote.
probe_contract.stimulus: Present it again later, or for a reused request identifier.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if it is accepted again.
probe_contract.repair: Bind a nonce or epoch into the signed message and reject reuse.

controls.title: Unauthenticated principal accepted
controls.question: Can a request obtain a principal's grants by naming the principal without any credential?

probe_contract.setup: Grant a capability to principal P.
probe_contract.stimulus: Submit a request naming P with no signature or credential.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the request is allowed.
probe_contract.repair: Require a credential verified against a key registered for P.

controls.title: Principal key is self-attested
controls.question: Is the verifying key taken from the request instead of from a registry binding keys to principals?

probe_contract.setup: Grant a capability to principal P.
probe_contract.stimulus: Submit a request naming P, signed by a fresh key that the request itself supplies.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the request is allowed.
probe_contract.repair: Resolve P's key from a verifier-held registry.

controls.title: Bearer authorization not bound to a subject
controls.question: Can an authorization artifact issued for one purpose be used by any requesting principal?

probe_contract.setup: Issue a valid authorization artifact.
probe_contract.stimulus: Present it under several different requesting principals.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if it is accepted for principals it was not issued to.
probe_contract.repair: Bind a subject or audience into the signed artifact and check it against the requester.

controls.title: Approver signs without evaluating authority
controls.question: Does an approval or voting endpoint sign a positive decision without evaluating the request against the approver's own policy?

probe_contract.setup: An approver endpoint with a policy that would deny the request.
probe_contract.stimulus: Ask it to approve the request.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if it returns a signed approval.
probe_contract.repair: Evaluate the request under the approver's policy and sign that decision.

controls.title: Authorization not bound to the exact call
controls.question: Does one authorization artifact authorize calls with different call identities, targets or arguments?

probe_contract.setup: Issue one authorization artifact.
probe_contract.stimulus: Use it for two calls differing in call identity, target and amount.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if both are allowed.
probe_contract.repair: Bind the call identity or a canonical hash of the call into the artifact and recompute it at dispatch.

controls.title: Value constraint defeated by type confusion
controls.question: Can a numeric limit be bypassed by encoding the value as another JSON type, or by changing an unchecked unit such as currency?

probe_contract.setup: Authorize with a value limit L.
probe_contract.stimulus: Submit values above L encoded as string, float, negative number and object, and under another unit.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if any is allowed.
probe_contract.repair: Reject values that are not exactly the expected type and unit.

controls.title: Resource constraint not canonicalised
controls.question: Can a resource or path restriction be escaped by traversal segments or a sibling sharing the prefix?

probe_contract.setup: Authorize with a restriction to resource prefix R.
probe_contract.stimulus: Request R/../outside and R_sibling/x.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if either is allowed.
probe_contract.repair: Canonicalise and compare component-wise.

controls.title: Policy evaluated after the effect
controls.question: Is an intent or semantic policy evaluated only after the protected action has executed, so a violating action still takes effect?

probe_contract.setup: Configure a policy forbidding a specific effect, in the system's fail-closed mode.
probe_contract.stimulus: Request that effect through the normal execution path.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the effect occurs, even when a violation is reported afterwards.
probe_contract.repair: Evaluate the policy before dispatch.

controls.title: Audit log tail truncation undetected
controls.question: Can the most recent committed audit records be deleted from persisted state without the integrity check noticing?

probe_contract.setup: Produce several committed audit batches.
probe_contract.stimulus: Delete the newest committed batch from persisted state; leave any stored head pointer alone.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if integrity verification still succeeds.
probe_contract.repair: Compare the stored head with the recomputed chain head, and anchor it externally.

controls.title: Merkle root ambiguous under odd-node duplication
controls.question: Do two different leaf sets produce the same Merkle root because the odd node is duplicated or leaves and nodes share a hash domain?

probe_contract.setup: Leaves [h1, h2, h3].
probe_contract.stimulus: Compute the root for [h1, h2, h3] and [h1, h2, h3, h3].
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if the roots are equal.
probe_contract.repair: Promote the odd node unchanged and domain-separate leaves and nodes (RFC 6962).

controls.title: Key exchange with an unauthenticated peer
controls.question: Does a node complete a key exchange with a peer it has no registered identity for?

probe_contract.setup: A node with an empty or restricted peer registry.
probe_contract.stimulus: Initiate a handshake from an unregistered peer.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if a shared secret is derived and a response returned.
probe_contract.repair: Refuse unregistered peers and sign a transcript that includes both identities.

controls.title: Bound evidence digest is a constant
controls.question: Is a digest presented as binding a suite run equal to the digest of a fixed string, so it binds nothing about the subject?

probe_contract.setup: A producer evidence package claiming bound suite digests.
probe_contract.stimulus: Hash the canonical form the producer documents for a successful run of an arbitrary project.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if it equals the recorded digest.
probe_contract.repair: Bind subject-specific facts (source tree, lockfile, test outcomes).

controls.title: Evidence package does not attest the code under assessment
controls.question: Does the producer's evidence omit the source being assessed, record a commit other than the assessed revision, and leave that unchecked by its verifier?

probe_contract.setup: The producer evidence package at the assessed revision.
probe_contract.stimulus: Inspect which files are attested, which commit is recorded and whether the verifier compares it with the checkout.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if source is unattested, the commit differs and the verifier does not check it.
probe_contract.repair: Attest the source tree hash and have the verifier enforce it.

controls.title: Stale evidence re-sealable under a new commit
controls.question: Can the producer re-sign earlier suite evidence while stamping the current commit, without recording where the evidence was produced?

probe_contract.setup: The producer's evidence generator.
probe_contract.stimulus: Inspect whether a reuse mode exists and whether the producing commit is recorded separately.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if reuse is possible and only the current commit is stamped.
probe_contract.repair: Record the evidence-producing commit and refuse reuse across commits.

controls.title: Verifier trust anchor shipped inside the package
controls.question: Does the producer's verifier authenticate the package with a public key shipped inside the package, without using an out-of-band anchor?

probe_contract.setup: The producer's verifier.
probe_contract.stimulus: Inspect which key file it verifies against and whether the declared out-of-band anchor is ever used.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if only the packaged key is used.
probe_contract.repair: Verify against a key obtained out of band or cross-signed by the previous key.

controls.title: Evidence totals not derived from the run
controls.question: Are reported test totals hard-coded rather than parsed from the run transcript?

probe_contract.setup: The producer's evidence generator.
probe_contract.stimulus: Inspect how totals are computed.
probe_contract.observation: OBSERVED if a total is a literal conditioned only on overall success.
probe_contract.repair: Parse totals from the transcript.
